name: Cards
description: Entity detail as a uniform grid of read-only info cards — one record's facts grouped into label/value blocks.

notes: left navigation rail — Organisms/Navigation
path back to the parent list — Molecules/BreadCrumbs
record title, status pill, and one or two actions — Atoms/Typography/Title, Atoms/DictionaryBadge, Atoms/Buttons/Button
a grouped block of label/value pairs — Molecules/Card
responsive equal-width grid holding the cards — Atoms/GridTiles/Grid

name: Cards — deal
description: Rich deal/entity overview — a mixed-height grid of section cards with header actions, badges, progress, and an embedded mini-table.

notes: left navigation rail — Organisms/Navigation
path back through the pipeline — Molecules/BreadCrumbs
deal name with inline edit + last-changed meta line — Atoms/Typography/Title, Atoms/IconButton
titled card with an optional header action (→ navigate or ✎ edit) — Molecules/Card, Atoms/IconButton
stage label, progress bar, probability — Atoms/ProgressBar, Atoms/DictionaryBadge
compact schedule/list rendered inside a card — Organisms/Table/Details
numeric counters on labels (documents, parties) — Atoms/BadgeCounter

name: Cards — links
description: Navigation hub / index — labelled columns of cards, each holding grouped lists of links to sub-sections.

notes: left navigation rail — Organisms/Navigation
short path, usually just Home — Molecules/BreadCrumbs
section title only, no actions — Atoms/Typography/Title
label above each column of cards — Atoms/Header/DashboardGroupHeader
a card grouping a titled list of navigation links — Molecules/Card, Atoms/Link/Link

name: Table
description: Full-page data table — registers, payment schedules, queues with filter, sortable rows, status, and a totals + pagination footer.

notes: left navigation rail — Organisms/Navigation
path back to the parent section — Molecules/BreadCrumbs
title + secondary action and a primary "+" action — Atoms/Typography/Title, Atoms/Buttons/Button
filter trigger and active-filter chips — Organisms/FiltersModal, Organisms/FiltersChips
dense sortable rows with status pills and a row-overflow menu — Organisms/Table/*, Atoms/DictionaryBadge, Atoms/Buttons/ContextMenuButton
aggregate totals on the left, rows-per-page + pager on the right — Organisms/Table/DataInteraction
